description: Variation of condition 2 (approved plans) to allow approved drawings to comply with building regulations followingplanning permission 01054/141-149/P35 dated 15/10/2019 for erection of a part six/part eight storey building with single storey "garden wing" to the rear comprising 25 flats and associated landscaping, amenity areas and parking.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be commenced by 15 October 2022, and not later.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted:

Approved Plans:
Design and Access Statement (dated March 2019), 5011/D/01, H-SK-03 Rev A, H-SK-02 Rev A, H-SK-01 Rev A, 05318, Planning Statement (dated 27th March 2019), Energy and Sustainability Statement (dated 20th March 2019), Design Report rev B (dated March 2019), Environmental Noise Assessment, Desk- Based Heritage Assessment (dated 25th March 2019), Flood Smart Report (dated 20th March 2019), Drainage Assessment Form (dated 19th March 2019), Air Quality Assessment (dated 22nd March 2019), SK08 Rev A, Transport Statement (dated February 2019), Daylight and Sunlight Report (dated March 2019) and Desk Study/Preliminary Risk Assessment Report and appendices (dated 22nd March 2019). Received: 11th April 2019. SK 05 Rev B. Received: 11th June 2019. SK 04 Rev C, Greenfield Runoff Volume, ICP SUDS Mean Annual Flood, Summary results for 100 year return period, Summary of Results for 30 Year Return Period, Summary of Result for 1 year Return Period, Operation and maintenance requirements for green roofs, Operation and maintenance requirements for attenuation storage tanks and drainage statement (dated 19th June 2019).  Received 19th June 2019. 

New Plans:
Full SAP Calculations, received 08/03/2021. Brick samples, received 27/01/2021. Drawing SK04(D), received 02/10/2020. Drawings SK02(G), SK03(G), SK05(G), SK06(G), SK07(E), SK09(G), SK10(F) and SK11(G), and Accommodation Schedule (4mar21revG) and Equitone Fibre Cement Fa?ade Materials samples/brochures, received 01/09/2020. Schedule of changes to planning drawings, received 11/05/2020.

Condition : 3 - The approved development shall be carried out in strict accordance with the details specified in this application (in respect of the cladding materials for the main building and the brickwork for the single storey element, and other general finishes) and with the details approved pursuant to 01054/141/149/P35(3-16) dated 22 February 2021 (in respect of balcony structures [screens/balustrades/soffits] and any other materials or fittings).

Condition : 4 - A)	The development shall be implemented in strict accordance with the previously approved Energy Strategy (dated 20th March 2019), and with the full Design Stage calculations assessed under the Standard Assessment Procedure included within this submission.

B)	Prior to first occupation of the building(s), evidence (e.g. photographs, installation contracts and As-Built certificates under the Standard Assessment Procedure) shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing to show that the development has been constructed in accordance with the approved Energy Strategy and Design Stage calculations, and any subsequent approved revisions.

C)	Upon final commencement of operation of the heat pump, suitable devices for the monitoring of the heat pump shall have been installed, and the monitored data shall be submitted automatically to a monitoring web-platform at daily intervals for a period of three years from the point of full operation.

Condition : 5 - Prior to first occupation of the building(s) evidence (schedule of fittings and manufactures literature) should be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing to show that the development has been constructed in accordance with the internal water use calculations approved pursuant to 01054/141-149/P35(5a-6a) dated 14 August 2020.

Condition : 6 - The development shall not be occupied until evidence (e.g. photographs and copies of installation contracts) has been submitted to the Local Planning Authority to demonstrate that the development has been carried out in accordance with the details approved pursuant to 01054/141-149/P35(5a-6a) dated 14 August 2020.

Condition : 7 - Prior to the first occupation of the hereby approved development the proposed play space as shown on the submitted plans shall be fully implemented and ready for use and shall be thereafter retained as such without obstruction for the duration of the development.

Condition : 8 - The development shall be carried out in full accordance with the Ground Remediation Strategy and Site Investigation Report (with associated plans/documentation) approved pursuant to 01054/141-149/P35(8a-8b) dated 19 January 2021.

During the course of the development, the Local Planning Authority shall be notified immediately if additional contamination is discovered during the course of the development. A competent person shall assess the additional contamination, and shall submit appropriate amendments to the scheme for decontamination in writing to the Local Planning Authority for approval before any work on that aspect of development continues. 

Before the development is first brought into use, the agreed scheme for decontamination/remediation referred to above, including amendments, shall be fully implemented and a written validation (closure) report submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval.

Condition : 9 - Notwithstanding the submitted Environmental Noise Assessment, the building shall be constructed so as to provide sound insulation against externally generated noise of not less than the standards outlined in BS8233:2014 (page 24 table 4) with windows shut and other means of ventilation provided. The sound insulation works shall be completed before the building is first occupied or brought into use and retained thereafter.

Condition : 10 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8am to 6pm on Mondays to Friday and 9am to 1pm on Saturdays and not at all on Sundays and Public Holidays.

Condition : 11 - No development shall take place, including any works of demolition, until a Construction Logistics Plan (including traffic management plan and construction vehicle swept path analysis) has been submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planning authority. The approved Plan shall accord with TfL Guidance and shall be adhered to throughout the construction period. The Plan shall include:

i.	a site plan (showing the areas set out below)
ii.	confirmation that a pre-start record of site conditions on the adjoining public highway will be undertaken with Hounslow Highways and a commitment to repair any damage caused
iii.	provision for the parking of vehicles of site operatives and visitors 
iv.	provisions for loading, unloading and storage of plant and materials within the site
v.	details of access to the site, including means to control and manage access and egress of vehicles to and from the site for the duration of construction including phasing arrangements 
vi.	the erection and maintenance of security hoarding including decorative displays and facilities for public viewing, where appropriate 
vii.	provision of wheel washing facilities at the site exit and a commitment to sweep adjacent roads when required and at the request of the council
viii.	a scheme for recycling/disposing of waste resulting from demolition and construction works
ix.	measures to ensure the safety of all users of the public highway especially cyclists and pedestrians in the vicinity of the site and especially at the access
x.	commitment to liaise with other contractors in the vicinity of the site to maximise the potential for consolidation and to minimise traffic impacts
xi.	avoidance of peak hours for deliveries and details of a booking system to avoid vehicles waiting on the public highway
xii.	all necessary traffic orders and other permissions required to allow safe access to the site to be secured and implemented prior to commencement of construction

Condition : 12 - The development shall be carried out in full accordance with the privacy screening measures approved pursuant to 01054/141-149/P35(3-16) dated 22 February 2021; the approved measures shall have been implemented prior to first occupation of any of the approved units.

Condition : 13 - Prior to the occupation of the hereby approved development the hard and soft landscaping around the site and proposed amenity areas shall be fully implemented in strict accordance with approved drawing numbers H-SK-01 Rev A, H-SK-02 Rev A and H-SK-03 Rev A, received on 11th April 2019.

Condition : 14 - The development shall be carried out in full accordance with the waste and recycling arrangements (storage and management) approved pursuant to 01054/141-149/P35(14) dated 15 December 2020, with the approved waste and recycling stores made available for use as approved prior to first occupation.

Condition : 15 - Prior to the occupation of the hereby approved development, the cycle store shall be constructed strictly in accordance with approved plan numbered SK 04 Rev D, received on 2nd October 2020, and shall thereafter be retained as such, kept free from obstruction at all times, for the remainder of the development.

Condition : 16 - The development shall be carried out in full accordance with the final detailed drainage designs and associated information (details of additional attenuation storage; detailed maintenance plan for drainage feature components; evidence of necessary approvals from Thames Water to allow surface water runoff to enter the sewer network) approved pursuant to 01054/141-149/P35(3-16) dated 22 February 2021.

Condition : 17 - Prior to occupation of the development, the applicant must submit for review and approval by the Local Planning Authority evidence that the drainage system has been built as per the final detailed drainage designs through the submission of photographs and copies of installation contracts, and written confirmation that the drainage features will be managed as per the detailed maintenance plan for the lifetime of the development.

Condition : 18 - A minimum of four Wheelchair User Dwellings, built to Building Regulations M4(3) standards, shall be provided in accordance with the approved plans. These units shall be retained as such for the duration of the development.

Condition : 19 - Prior to the occupation of the hereby approved development the car parking spaces as shown on the submitted plans shall be made available for use and shall be maintained as such for the duration of the development without obstruction.
Condition : 20 - Any boilers installed in the hereby approved development shall be Ultra Low Emissions (<40 mg NOx/kWh) and in accordance with the London Plan Sustainable Design and Construction SPG.
Condition : 21 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the mitigation measures proposed in the submitted Air Quality Assessment during construction and operational phases.
